mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in < 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger short-term equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) in a manufacturing slowdown regime forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and profit visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 persons signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and positive equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in < 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals heightened inflation expectations that trigger monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic weakness that forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), payroll growth exceeding 100,000 persons (PAYEMS) signals strong economic conditions that support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 100000 and UNRATE < 4.5%.
